data.body_html:
The F1 Grand Prix 2033 in Marbella is set to be the most exhilarating race weekend on the Costa del Sol. Instead of battling crowds on land, experience the action from the Mediterranean with a private Marbella boat rental for F1 Grand Prix weekend. Charter a luxury yacht from Puerto Banús, anchor metres from the circuit, and enjoy uninterrupted views of the race while sipping cava. Our fleet includes boats for 5 to 12 guests, all with a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks included. Prices start at €749 for 2 hours on a Tier A boat like the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39. For a premium experience, the Mangusta 80 (€4,719 minimum 4 hours) includes a free jet ski. Book via WhatsApp to secure your spot—race weekend slots are limited.

Why Choose a Boat for the F1 Grand Prix?

Watching the F1 from a yacht offers a unique perspective: you see the cars flash past the coastal straight, hear the engines roar over the water, and feel the buzz of the paddock from a private vantage point. No queues, no packed grandstands, no sunburn—just you, your guests, and the race. Our charters depart from Puerto Banús, just 15 minutes from the circuit, so you can maximise time on the water. With a skipper handling navigation, you relax and focus on the action. Inclusions like beer, wine, and snacks keep the mood festive. For groups of up to 12, it's the ultimate hospitality experience.

Our Fleet for Race Weekend

We have 16 boats available, each departing from Puerto Banús. Here are the top picks for the F1 weekend:

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) – €749 for 2 hours, €2,299 for 8 hours. Ideal for small groups.
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – Same pricing, more capacity.
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) – €4,719 minimum 4 hours, includes free jet ski.
  • Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) – Ultimate luxury for corporate hospitality.
  • Bandido (11.5m, 8 pax) – Sleek and fast for a sporty vibe.

All boats include licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, VAT, and a selection of drinks and snacks. For pricing on other models, contact us via WhatsApp.

Race Day Itinerary

Your charter day typically runs like this:

  • 10:00 – Meet at Puerto Banús, board your yacht, meet the skipper.
  • 10:30 – Depart, cruise along the coast to the best anchoring spot near the circuit.
  • 11:00–14:00 – Watch practice or qualifying (Friday/Saturday) or the main race (Sunday).
  • 14:00–15:00 – Enjoy lunch onboard or take a dip in the sea.
  • 15:00 – Return to port, or extend your charter to explore the coast.

You can customise the schedule. Many guests book a full-day charter (8 hours) to combine race viewing with a coastal cruise to Cabopino or Estepona.

What's Included in Every Charter

Every booking includes:

  • Licensed skipper (English & Spanish speaking)
  • Fuel for the full charter duration
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (crisps, nuts, olives)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21% tax)

Tier B boats (Mangusta 80 variants) also include a free jet ski. There are no hidden fees—what you see is what you get.

How to Book

Booking is simple: send us a message on WhatsApp with your preferred boat, date, and duration. We'll confirm availability and send a payment link for the 50% deposit. The balance is due 7 days before departure. We recommend booking at least 4–6 weeks in advance for the F1 weekend. For last-minute inquiries, check availability via WhatsApp—sometimes cancellations open up slots.

For more general information on Marbella boat rental, visit our main page.

Frequently Asked Questions

When is the F1 Grand Prix 2033 in Marbella?

The F1 Grand Prix 2033 is scheduled for the last weekend of May, with practice on Friday, qualifying on Saturday, and the race on Sunday. Exact dates are confirmed by the FIA closer to the event.

How close can my boat get to the F1 circuit?

You can anchor within 200–300 metres of the coastal section of the track near Puerto Banús. From this spot, you get a clear view of the cars speeding along the shoreline and the pit-lane action.

What is included in the boat rental price?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). Tier B boats also include a free jet ski.

Can I bring my own food and drinks?

Yes, you are welcome to bring extra food or drinks. The boat already provides a selection of beverages and snacks. There is a cooler and storage space onboard.

How do I book a boat for the F1 race weekend?

Contact us via WhatsApp to check availability and confirm your charter. We recommend booking at least 4–6 weeks in advance, as race weekend slots fill quickly.

What is the maximum number of guests per charter?

Our fleet accommodates from 5 up to 12 guests. For example, the Azimut 58 Flybridge and Ferretti 94 both take 12 guests. Smaller boats like the Dubhe (8m) take 5 guests.

Is there a deposit required?

Yes, a 50% deposit is required to secure your booking. The balance is due 7 days before departure. All payments are processed securely via bank transfer or card.

What happens if the weather is bad on race day?

We monitor forecasts closely. If conditions are unsafe, we offer a full refund or reschedule to the next available day. Safety is our top priority.
